text:
alyssa_billing: Heads-up — during month close I'm seeing a discrepancy between dashboard and invoice totals for AcmeCorp. Dashboard shows $12,345.67 but invoice total is $13,725.21. Looks like ~11% higher on invoice. :thinking:
sam_support: Can you paste the invoice id + account id and a screenshot of the dashboard row?
alyssa_billing: invoice INV-2024-ACME-9876, account acme_corp_42. Screenshot attached to thread (not in this export). The plan tier changed mid-cycle (standard -> pro) on 2024-02-18 and the customer's billing currency is EUR but they pay in USD via card.
jordan_finance: @alyssa_billing thanks. My first guess: proration + FX rounding + conversion happening at different pipeline stages (dashboard uses daily-exchange-rate, invoice uses snapshot rate at finalization). Need to check proration factor applied to plan lines and whether currency conversion is applied before or after rounding. :mag:
billing_bot: Invoice generated INV-2024-ACME-9876 total EUR 12,800.15 (converted to USD 13,725.21 using rate 1.0723 at finalize).
maria_accounts: Do we store both base_currency amounts and converted amounts in ledger entries? IIRC we store base_amounts (EUR) and convert at finalize to USD for invoice PDF, but dashboard aggregates converted amounts daily.
alyssa_billing: right — dashboard uses daily conversion table `fx_rates_daily` at UTC date, invoice uses `fx_snapshot` captured at finalize job runtime. That could explain drift. But 11% seems bigger than normal FX drift.
sam_support: Could plan proration be double-applied because of a retry? Any idempotency issues in `monthly_billing_finalize`?
devin_sre: I'll check the finalize job logs for that invoice window. Quick look: I see a finalize job run at 2024-03-01T00:01Z and a retry at 2024-03-01T00:04Z due to transient DB timeout. The retry log shows: "apply_proration_lines start -> complete" twice for invoice INV-2024-ACME-9876.
jordan_finance: That matches — double-apply of proration lines would increase invoice total. We should check ledger entries for duplicate proration entries and check `idempotency_key` handling.
alyssa_billing: SQL I ran (abbreviated):
```sql
SELECT l.type, l.amount_base, l.currency, l.proration_factor, l.idempotency_key
FROM ledger_entries l
WHERE l.invoice_id = 'INV-2024-ACME-9876'
ORDER BY l.created_at;
```
sam_support: Results?
alyssa_billing: Two proration lines present: PRORATE-STD-TO-PRO and PRORATE-STD-TO-PRO (same description, different ids), both amount_base EUR 1,500.00 and same proration_factor 0.5, idempotency_key null on second entry.
maria_accounts: That explains ~€1,500 extra -> converted to USD ~1,608 which covers most of the gap. Why was idempotency key null on retry? The finalize job should populate `finalize_run_id` as idempotency.
devin_sre: Looking at retry path: first run set finalize_run_id 'FR-2141590000', second retry cleared transient context and re-ran path without sticking finalize_run_id into insert statement due to exception handling bug. So second insert bypassed dedupe.
jordan_finance: Good find. Remediation: mark the duplicate ledger entry as void (ledger void_reason = 'duplicate_finalize_retry') and regenerate invoice total. Also add a one-off adjustment to dashboard to reflect corrected ledger if necessary.
sam_support: Steps to reproduce locally: 1) create test account with plan change mid-cycle 2) run `monthly_billing_finalize` with an injected DB timeout after proration compute but before marking finalize_run_id 3) re-run job and confirm duplicate proration lines appear.
alyssa_billing: I'll run the repro in staging and open a support ticket to AcmeCorp with corrected totals and a credit notice.
maria_accounts: Also need to check FX rates: duplicate proration in EUR then conversion at finalize used rate 1.0723; dashboard used daily rates (1.0640 average) so small additional variance. After removing duplicate proration, amounts align: dashboard USD 12,345.67 vs corrected invoice USD 12,385.12 (within expected rounding).
devin_sre: I'll push a hotfix to the finalize job to ensure `finalize_run_id` is always applied inside a DB transaction and errors stop re-insert path. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/482 (linked).
jordan_finance: Action items: 1) @devin_sre deploy hotfix (ETA today EOD) 2) @alyssa_billing void duplicate ledger + regenerate invoice + issue credit/refund + notify customer (ETA tomorrow) 3) @maria_accounts run a reconciliation job for all invoices finalized between 2024-03-01T00:00Z and 2024-03-01T00:10Z to find duplicates.
alyssa_billing: acknowledged. I'll create the customer communication and add credit note draft.
sam_support: tagging :eyes: will follow up on the customer side.
billing_bot: reconciliation job started job_id RJ-2141590500 for window 2024-03-01T00:00Z-2024-03-01T00:10Z.
jordan_finance: Keep this thread updated with reconciliation CSV and final customer message.
alyssa_billing: will do. Thanks all.
